## 1. About Urban Craft & Co. & Commercial Status

Urban Craft & Co. is a sole proprietorship based in New Delhi, India, engaged in the curation, bespoke branding, assembly, and pan-India supply of corporate gift sets, employee onboarding kits, promotional merchandise, executive leatherette accessories, and lifestyle drinkware.

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and interaction with our website, digital product catalogues, and online enquiry forms. By accessing our website, browsing our collections, or submitting an enquiry, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms.

## 2. Scope of Website: Enquiry-Only Platform

- **No Direct E-Commerce Checkout:** Our website operates exclusively as an online portfolio, digital showcase, and business enquiry facility. It does not contain an automated shopping cart, payment gateway, or instantaneous checkout mechanism.
- **Enquiries Do Not Create Orders:** Submitting an enquiry through our online forms, shortlisting items in your favorites list, or requesting a catalog download does _not_ constitute a binding purchase contract, nor does it place, confirm, or reserve an order with Urban Craft & Co.
- An order is created and confirmed only through a separate, bilateral written process, typically involving an approved formal quotation, signed Purchase Order (PO), or mutually confirmed commercial statement of work.

## 3. Quotations, Pricing & Commercial Terms

Because corporate gifting orders vary significantly based on volume, branding complexity, materials, and logistics, all pricing is customized:

- **Written Quotations:** Following receipt of your enquiry, our team will prepare and issue a formal written quotation specifying unit prices, applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST), branding setup fees, packaging specifications, and delivery charges.
- **Validity:** Quotations remain valid for the period stated on the quote document (typically 15 calendar days from issuance) to account for raw material and freight fluctuations.
- **Taxes & Statutory Compliance:** Invoices are raised in accordance with Indian tax laws, displaying our registered Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN: `07AEGPF3058P1Z7`).
- **Payment Milestones:** Standard B2B terms generally require an advance deposit upon order confirmation to fund raw material procurement and production setup, with the remaining balance due against dispatch proof or delivery as mutually agreed in the quotation. Payments are accepted through standard banking channels (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, or corporate cheques).

## 4. Product Representation, Materials & Tolerances

We pride ourselves on superior craftsmanship and make every reasonable effort to display product dimensions, materials, colours, and finishing options accurately.

- **Natural & Handcrafted Variations:** Many of our gifts incorporate natural materials such as bamboo, cork, canvas, jute, natural leather, or handcrafted paper. Inherent variations in grain, texture, natural colour tones, and dye lots are normal characteristics of genuine materials and do not constitute manufacturing defects.
- **Screen & Digital Calibration:** Digital product photography and screen displays may show slight colour nuances compared to tangible physical products under different ambient lighting.
- **Material Tolerances:** Minor dimensional tolerances within industry standards (±2–5% for soft goods and textiles) are standard across bulk manufacturing.

## 5. Customisation, Branding & Digital Proofing

Personalized branding—including laser engraving, screen printing, UV flatbed printing, debossing, foil stamping, and embroidery—is executed to precise specifications:

- **Proof Approval Obligation:** Before any branding or manufacturing begins, we generate a digital artwork mockup or 2D/3D proof for client review. The client is strictly responsible for reviewing and verifying all elements, including spelling, designations, Pantone colour matches, logo scale, and positioning.
- **Production Commences Upon Approval:** Branding setup and production will not proceed without explicit, written client approval (via email or authorized messaging).
- **Client Intellectual Property Warranty:** You represent and warrant that your organization owns or holds all necessary licences and authorisations for any logo, trademark, graphic, or design supplied to us. You agree to hold Urban Craft & Co. harmless from any third-party intellectual property infringement claims arising from your supplied artwork.

## 6. Order Confirmation & Execution

An order is deemed confirmed and scheduled for production only when all of the following conditions are met:

1. The written quotation or Purchase Order is formally accepted by both parties.
2. The digital artwork proofs have been approved in writing by the client.
3. The agreed advance payment or credit terms have been received and verified by our finance desk.

## 7. Shipping, Delivery & Transit

We arrange delivery across India through contracted express courier networks and surface cargo transporters. Specific delivery schedules, freight charges, and logistics terms are governed by our dedicated Shipping & Delivery Policy.

## 8. Cancellation, Returns & Quality Remedies

Submitting a website enquiry carries zero financial obligation and may be abandoned at any time prior to order confirmation.

Once an order is confirmed, bespoke procurement and custom branding begin. Cancellations, returns, and quality remediations are governed by our Cancellation, Returns & Refunds Policy. Because customized goods cannot be restocked or repurposed, change-of-mind cancellations after production begins are subject to actual costs incurred. Genuine transit damage, manufacturing defects, or material deviations from approved specifications will be promptly remedied.
